title: Inherited guest-friendship
intro: Diomedes and Glaucus renew a family bond and exchange armour. Hector reaches the Trojan gates.

notes.text: ξεῖνος, guest-friend, a reciprocal bond of hospitality; πατρώϊος, inherited from one's fathers; παλαιός, of long standing.
ξενίζω, entertain: 3sg aor; twenty days, acc of duration; ἐρύκω, keep: aor ptc.
πόρω, give: unaugmented 3pl 2aor; ξεινήϊα, guest-gifts, neut pl.
ζωστήρ, belt: acc sg; φοῖνιξ, purple / crimson dye: dat sg; φαεινός, gleaming.
δέπας, cup (neut); ἀμφικύπελλον, traditionally “two-handled,” exact design debated.
καταλείπω, leave behind: 1sg impf; εἶμι pres ptc, “when I came away.” He still owns the heirloom.
μιμνήσκομαι perf mid with present sense, remember; τυτθός, tiny / very young: acc sg with με.
καταλείπω, leave: unaugmented 3sg 2aor; κατ-λιπ- → καλλιπ-. Tydeus left Diomedes as a child.
ἀπόλλυμι 3sg 2aor mid, perished; the earlier expedition against Thebes, not the Trojan war.
τώ, therefore; Ἄργος uncontracted dat sg; μέσσος = μέσος. “In the heart of Argos.”
ἱκνέομαι 1sg aor mid subj, future eventuality; τῶν δῆμον, their land, the Lycians'.
ἀλέομαι, avoid: 1pl pres mid subj, exhortation; “let us avoid each other's spears.”
ὅμιλος, crowd / battle-throng: gen sg; even amid general fighting.
Supply εἰσί, “there are many … for me to kill”; κτείνω pres inf.
πόρω, grant: 3sg 2aor subj; κιχάνω, overtake: epic 1sg 2aor subj. “Whomever a god grants and my feet catch.”
ἐναίρω, slay: epic pres inf; δύναμαι 2sg pres mid subj, uncontracted -ηαι.
ἐπαμείβω, exchange: 1pl fut act, used as proposal; τεύχεα, armour.
γιγνώσκω 3pl root aor subj; purpose after ὄφρα, “so these men too may know.”
Two aor act ptcs, nom dual: speaking, then leaping down; καθ᾽ ἵππων, from their chariots.
λαμβάνω unaugmented 3dual 2aor; πιστόω 3pl aor mid, pledged faith. Dual shifts to plural.
ἐξαιρέω 3sg 2aor mid, took away his wits; narrator's explanation of Glaucus' unequal bargain.
“Gold [armour] for bronze”; gen of exchange after ἄμειβε.
ἑκατόμβοιος, worth a hundred cattle; ἐννεάβοιος, worth nine. Acc things given, gen things received.
Scaean gates; φηγός, oak, landmark beside Troy.
θέω, run: unaugmented 3pl impf; women crowd around Hector.
εἴρομαι, ask: pres mid ptc; κασίγνητος, brother; ἔτης, kinsman / companion: acc pl.
πόσις, husband: epic acc pl; ἄνωγα, command: 3sg past here; tells all to pray.
ἑξείης, in turn; κῆδος, grief: neut pl; ἐφάπτω 3sg plup pass, “sorrows were attached / hung over many.”
